The decision comes from the project's recorded memory. A later entry switched the runtime from async-std to tokio and superseded the earlier one. The repository has no other record of it, since a search for tokio and async-std found nothing.

This checkout is a Go project (gin), so the recorded tokio decision doesn't match the code here. I wrote it as recorded and didn't try to reconcile it.
